facts.business: Mihika Industries Limited is engaged in trading and distribution activities with emphasis on procurement, customer relationships, inventory management and operational efficiency.

auditor.name: M/s. S K Bhavsar & Company, Chartered Accountants, Ahmedabad
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: (1) Management has not furnished balance confirmation letters, party-wise reconciliation statements, and age-wise analysis for certain Trade Receivable and Trade Payable balances as at 31st March 2026, so existence, completeness, accuracy, and recoverability could not be verified; impact not ascertainable. (2) Satisfactory supporting documents for completeness of valuation of inventory as on 31st March 2026 were not provided. (3) Company has not appointed an Internal Auditor for the entire Financial Year 2025-26, constituting non-compliance with Section 138 of the Companies Act, 2013. (4) Loans granted for which confirmations and supporting loan agreements were not made available for verification; accuracy, recoverability and interest-free nature could not be verified.
